name: sackur_tetrode_entropy
title: Sackur-Tetrode absolute entropy of helium
summary: Absolute molar entropy of helium (300 K, 1 atm) from the Sackur-Tetrode equation of statistical mechanics, checked against the absolute entropy of the EES/NASA ideal-gas database: the two values agree within 1e-6 relative (126.172 J/mol-K).
language_features: built-in constants NA#, k#, h#, R#

origin.notes: Example 15.5-1 of Klein & Nellis, Thermodynamics (Cambridge University Press, 2011); EES example (c) F-Chart Software, MIT via EES-Community/ees-examples. The binary .eez companion (EES 11.915) carries the stored solution: stale for the equations as saved (stored T record 1000 K vs the saved T = 300 K), re-checked at its own run point only. Original download page in the file header: https://fchartsoftware.com/ees/examples/examples_thermodynamics_2011/chapter%2015/example%2015.5-1.eez

verification.summary: Runs in 0 iterations. Shipped 300 K run: s_bar equals an analytical recomputation to 2.6e-13; s_bar_EES = 126172.11 J/kmol-K matches the JANAF helium entropy (126.150 J/mol-K at 298.15 K, 1 bar, cp = 5/2 R, adjusted to 300 K, 1 atm) to 2.4e-5; the two agree within 9.6e-7. Stale EES stored records (T = 1000 K) reproduced by a work-folder re-run at that point, max rel diff 6.7e-4.
verification.reference: Analytical recomputation of the Sackur-Tetrode value; JANAF/NIST absolute entropy of helium (S(298.15 K, 1 bar) = 126.150 J/mol-K, cp = 5/2 R); stale EES stored solution of the .eez companion, compared with tools/compare_solution.py --ees-units
verification.notes: max_rel_diff is the maximum actual relative difference of the stored-point re-run (T = 1000 K, in the work folder, not the shipped baseline): 6.7e-4 on s_bar_EES (EES/CoolProp ideal-gas He data), 1.8e-5 on s_bar, 4.7e-6 on m; compare_solution.py reports '0 differ (rtol=0.001)'. At the shipped 300 K run point the maximum deviation against the analytical/publication references is 2.4e-5 (on s_bar_EES vs JANAF). The 7 only-in-CoolSolve variables are the built-in constants, T_K and G$.

history.action: added (T-IMPORT card C-519, candidate EEX-160 of the ees_examples inventory); verified analytically, against the published JANAF helium entropy, and against the stale EES stored solution at its own 1000 K run point
